SELECT WAFER_SEQ , DIEID, X, Y , CASE WHEN PARABIN > ( TO_NUMBER(:gap) - 1) THEN ( TO_NUMBER(:gap) - 1) WHEN PARABIN < 0 THEN 0 ELSE PARABIN END BIN , "??" FROM ( SELECT WAFER_SEQ , DIE_NUM AS DIEID, X, Y, "??" ,ROUND( ("??" - C.MINVALUE) / ((C.MAXVALUE - C.MINVALUE)/ ( TO_NUMBER(:gap) - 1)) , 0) AS PARABIN FROM TD_?? ,(SELECT MAX("??") MAXVALUE ,MIN("??") MINVALUE FROM TD_??,(SELECT LSL,USL FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE 1 = 1 AND PROGRAM=:program AND PARAM_NAME='??') S WHERE WAFER_SEQ=:waferSeq AND "??" BETWEEN S.LSL AND S.USL) C WHERE WAFER_SEQ=:waferSeq )

FROM ( SELECT WAFER_SEQ , DIE_NUM AS DIEID, X, Y, "??" ,DECODE(C.MAXVALUE - C.MINVALUE, 0, 0,ROUND( ("??" - C.MINVALUE) / ((C.MAXVALUE - C.MINVALUE)/ ( TO_NUMBER(:gap) - 1)) , 0)) AS PARABIN FROM TD_?? ,( SELECT MAX("??") MAXVALUE ,MIN("??") MINVALUE FROM TD_??, ( SELECT LSL,USL FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE 1 = 1 AND PROGRAM=:program AND PARAM_NAME='??' ) S WHERE WAFER_SEQ=:waferSeq AND "??" BETWEEN S.LSL AND S.USL ) C WHERE WAFER_SEQ=:waferSeq ) ) GROUP BY BIN ORDER BY BIN

WHERE WAFER_SEQ IN (??) GROUP BY BIN) B WHERE A.BIN(+) = B.BIN ORDER BY BIN

SELECT DECODE(A.BIN,NULL,B.BIN,A.BIN) AS BIN , DECODE(A.BIN_NAME,NULL,'BIN' || B.BIN,A.BIN_NAME) AS BIN_NAME , CNT , NVL(COLOR, '#FFFFFF') AS COLOR , UPPER_LIMIT_CNT , LOWER_LIMIT_CNT FROM (WITH RT AS ( SELECT A.*, (DECODE(A.CUSTOMER, :customer, 1, 0) + DECODE(A.PRODUCT, :product, 10, 0) + DECODE(A.TESTAREA, :testarea, 20, 0) + DECODE(A.FORMAT, :format, 30, 0)) AS NUM FROM TQP_BINDESC A WHERE 1=1 AND A.CUSTOMER IN (' ', :customer) AND A.PRODUCT IN (' ', :product) AND A.TESTAREA IN (' ', :testarea) --AND A.FORMAT IN (' ', :format) ) SELECT * FROM RT WHERE 1=1 AND NUM = (SELECT MAX(NUM) FROM RT) ORDER BY BIN) A, (SELECT 1 AS BIN, 1 AS CNT FROM DUAL UNION SELECT CLASSNUMBER AS BIN, 1 AS CNT FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ = (SELECT STEP_SEQ FROM ( SELECT * FROM TQD_INSP_INFO WHERE LOT_ID = :lot_id AND WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND STEP_ID = :testarea ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) GROUP BY CLASSNUMBER) B WHERE A.BIN(+) = B.BIN ORDER BY BIN
